Finding a great gift for a coffee lover depends on their brewing style and experience level. You can explore curated selections directly through the [Coffee Gifts Catalog at John Lewis](https://www.johnlewis.com/browse/gifts/coffee-lovers-gifts/_/N-7gux).[[1]](https://www.johnlewis.com/browse/gifts/coffee-lovers-gifts/_/N-7gux)

### Coffee Samplers & Beans

- **[Whittard Coffees of the World Gift Set Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,mid:576462810924574735,imageDocid:7215815304574764168,gpcid:18196000965324565726,headlineOfferDocid:11337432035282223255,catalogid:8862728951902147453,productDocid:13486801858293505462,rds:CSS_PC_18196000965324565726%7CPC_18196000965324565726%7CPROD_CSS_PC_18196000965324565726%7CPROD_PC_18196000965324565726&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiH5oW1nquXAxUThv0HHTtJIncQxa4PegoIAggACAAIDBAL):** A bestselling 9-box single-origin ground coffee collection priced around £30.00 to £38.74.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:1158073438119308367,catalogid:12145335393675686761,gpcid:17275375432366895551,mid:576462308662923857&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:13486801858293505462,catalogid:8862728951902147453,gpcid:18196000965324565726,mid:576462810924574735&ibp=oshop)
- **Specialty Coffee Beans:** Bags from roasters like [Origin Coffee](https://www.origincoffee.co.uk/blogs/journal/coffee-lover-gift-guide) or [H.R.Higgins](https://www.hrhiggins.co.uk/collections/coffee-gifts) offering single-origin or signature blends (Resolute, Stronghold).[[1]](https://www.origincoffee.co.uk/blogs/journal/coffee-lover-gift-guide)[[2]](https://www.hrhiggins.co.uk/collections/coffee-gifts)

### Brewers & Gear

- **[Bialetti Moka Express Set Go to product viewer dialogue for this item.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:48,imageDocid:15646013349670264225,gpcid:17906280226791130911,headlineOfferDocid:1988465479907464734,catalogid:2193335294613380470,productDocid:5649630574713625871,rds:CSS_PC_17906280226791130911%7CPC_17906280226791130911%7CPROD_CSS_PC_17906280226791130911%7CPROD_PC_17906280226791130911&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwiH5oW1nquXAxUThv0HHTtJIncQxa4PegoIAggACAAIDBAc):** The classic 3-cup stove-top espresso maker bundled with Perfetto coffee, available around £35.99.[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,productid:5649630574713625871,catalogid:2193335294613380470,gpcid:17906280226791130911&ibp=oshop)
- **AeroPress / AeroPress Go:** Portable, versatile immersion brewers favored by daily drinkers and travelers, priced around £39.99 to £49.99.[[1]](https://www.hrhiggins.co.uk/collections/coffee-gifts)
- **Pour-Over & Kettles:** Hario V60 sets or precision swan-neck kettles for filter coffee enthusiasts.[[1]](https://www.hrhiggins.co.uk/collections/coffee-gifts)

### Books & Accessories

- **Books:** *The World Atlas of Coffee* or *How to Make the Best Coffee at Home* by James Hoffmann.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/jameshoffmanncoffee/videos/gift-ideas-for-intermediate-coffee-lovers/667494592223768/)
- **Scales & Tools:** Precision digital coffee scales, WDT tools, or custom tampers for espresso and pour-over fans.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tehnjU57xAs&t=11)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/jameshoffmanncoffee/posts/heres-some-idea-of-what-to-gift-a-coffee-lover-depending-on-their-level-of-exper/1098464598585451/)

To help narrow down the best choice, tell me:

- **What equipment** do they currently use (Nespresso, filter, espresso machine, instant)?
- What is your **budget**?
